description: Prefill the Search Bar Typing Animation Maker: a search bar animation: a query typed letter by letter, then the search button pressed. Returns a link that opens the Tool with these options; the user presses Export there to download the video. All options are optional. Icons, images and audio that need a file upload are not supported.

accent.description: Accent color of the search button. Default: "#2563eb".

cps.description: Typing speed in characters per second. Default: 8.

font.description: Font id of the text. Default: "inter".

hold.description: Seconds the final frame holds at the end. Default: 1.

lead.description: Seconds of empty search bar before typing starts. Default: 1.

look.description: Light or dark search bar style. Default: "light".

pause.description: Seconds between finishing typing and pressing the button. Default: 0.5.

press.description: Whether the search button is pressed after typing: 1 yes, 0 no. Default: true.

q.description: The search query that gets typed. Default: "how to make a video intro".

scale.description: Size of the search bar relative to the frame. Default: 100.

text.description: Color of the typed text. Default: "#202124".

name: create_search_bar_typing_animation
title: Search Bar Typing Animation Maker
